name: rippers-equipment
description: Rippers Unmasked — 1892 Equipment: the QA'd 1892-rethemed basic weapons, armor, shields and services as native Project FU Item packs. Personal-table module.

scripts.zip: rm -f rippers-equipment.zip && zip -r -q rippers-equipment.zip module.json README.md packs -x '*/.DS_Store'
scripts.release: gh release create v$npm_package_version -R RoscoeRackham/rippers-equipment --latest --title "rippers-equipment v$npm_package_version" --notes "rippers-equipment v$npm_package_version" ./module.json ./rippers-equipment.zip
scripts.publish: npm run build && npm run pack && npm run zip && npm run release
